subject: webb
excerpts: De uitvouwing verliep soepel.
Tijdens de ingebruikname van zes maanden moest Webb verder afkoelen, werden de spiegels uitgelijnd en de instrumenten gekalibreerd.
De uitvouwing bracht Webb in zijn volledige configuratie.

subject: webb
excerpts: Webb reached its fully deployed configuration in its second week.
The deployment proceeded smoothly, but reaching its final configuration was just one stage.
The telescope and instruments cooled for several weeks.
Mirror alignment followed in months two through four, then instrument-mode calibration in months five and six.
Webb’s second-week milestone completed deployment.
